load_draw_policy: clamp concentration and volume nonnegative within each posterior draw before multiplying event load
prediction_scope: complete 528 physical events x 10 prespecified Bayes analytes, observed and missing
observed_values_role: model likelihood and reference diagnostics only; never substituted for modeled predictions
annual_aggregation_hierarchy: sum physical-event values within Year + Treatment + Rep + Analyte + Draw
average replicate-specific annual plot totals within Year + Treatment + Analyte + Draw
observed_annual_completeness_unit: Year x Treatment x Rep x Analyte
observed_annual_interval: descriptive replicate minimum-to-maximum range for two complete plots; none for one complete plot

seasonal_stir.definition: sum treatment-specific STIR after the preceding crop's named harvest operation through the runoff observation date
seasonal_stir.same_day_rule: the named harvest operation closes the preceding crop; other operations recorded on that HarvestDate carry into the following crop
seasonal_stir.first_observed_season: left-censored because the preceding 2010 HarvestDate is unavailable; includes all STIR records available through each 2011 observation
seasonal_stir.bayesian_v3p1_usage: Season_STIR_toDate is used for runoff-volume and concentration; residue uses post-harvest seasonal STIR accumulated through the actual residue measurement date when known and PlantDate otherwise
seasonal_stir.ml_v3p1_usage: both Season_STIR_toDate and CumAll_STIR_toDate are candidate features in concentration and runoff-volume models

storm_handling.bayesian: retained as distinct Irrigation levels and mapped to numeric codes 11 and 12 for the existing linear irrigation-effect term
storm_handling.ml: retained as distinct categorical Irrigation levels
storm_handling.limitation: Bayes and ML retain framework-specific storm representations; they are not harmonized in v3p1
